## Rule

**Corpus-decoded 2026-06-07, numpy-replication verified 200,000/200,000.**
Grid is ALWAYS exactly 15×15 (in and out, 200k/200k). Input colors: {6 (shapes), 8 (background)} — color 0 never appears, so output ch0 is always dead. Output recolors every cell:

- color 6 stays **6**
- bg cell → **4** if there is ≥1 six strictly in EACH of the 4 cardinal directions (same row left AND right, same column above AND below) — "boxed" (donut interiors)
- elif ≥1 six in its 8-neighborhood → **3** (halo)
- else stays **8**

Priority: 6 > 4 > 3 > 8 (94% of boxed cells are also 8-adjacent — donut holes — so the priority is load-bearing). Output colors ⊆ {3,4,6,8}; channels 0,1,2,5,7,9 never fire.
Corpus margins (200k): 6s NEVER touch the border (rows/cols 0 and 14 → 13×13 core certified); max directional count 11; max 3×3 count A = 9 (shape cell incl. self), ≤8 on bg cells.

## Algorithm sketch

```python
s = grid == 6
left/right/up/down = directional "exists a 6 strictly that way" (cumsum > 0)
boxed = left & right & up & down & ~s
nb    = 3x3 neighbor count of s (excl. self)
out = np.full((15,15), 8); out[(nb>0) & ~boxed] = 3; out[boxed] = 4; out[s] = 6
```

All rungs: visible 265/265, truth 200,000/200,000, ab vs LIVE 200,265/200,265 byte_equal=true (decode-level). Builders + .onnx in `task125/prototypes/`.

**Boundary-leak discovery (border stress, 500 synthetic 15×15 {6,8} grids, 277 with border-6s)**: positive OFF-CENTER taps in a free-output conv leak across the X boundary — with a 6 at grid row/col 14, v1/v4's ch3 A-taps fire phantom cells at row/col 15 (outside the active grid). v1: 315/500 (223/223 on no-border grids); v4: 223/500 (223/223 clean); **v5: 500/500**. Corpus margin (6s at border = 0/200,000, same generator as hidden) protects v1–v4 in-distribution; v5 makes the leak structurally impossible (center-only positive taps ⇒ output = padded X exactly). LIVE is also immune (Pad-assembled).

**v6 = v4 + `P13 = Min(dL,dR,dU,dD)`** — variadic u8 Min (4-input, probed at opset 14) collapses the 3-Mul AND-chain into ONE charged tensor. **v7 = v5 + the same Min** (and is the rung to ship if any doubt about hidden border content).

**v4 architecture** (opset 14, all-u8 planes, output u8 [1,10,30,30]):
`Slice ch6 rows/cols 1..14 (F32 676) → Cast u8 (169) → Pad→s15 (225) → e15=Sub(1,s15) (225, border ring e=1 falls out free) ‖ 4× MaxPool 1×13/13×1 dir-dilations on s13 (676, 0 params) → 3× Mul AND-chain → P13 (507) → Pad→P15 (225, shared pads8 init) → X=Concat(s15,e15,P15) (675) → QLinearConv(W[10,3,3,3] i8, pads=[1,1,16,16]) = output (FREE #67)`.
Integer taps: ch3 = A−10P−10s, ch4 = P−2s, ch6 = s, ch8 = e−A−P, where A = 3×3 count computed INSIDE the output conv (never a tensor). INT32 accumulation exact; u8 saturation floors negatives to 0; decode (>0) per channel. The directional MaxPools are INCLUSIVE dilations — safe because only indicator signs are consumed and every shape-cell tap is suppressed by −k·s (this dodges the 2026-05-20 MaxPool≠Conv-counts trap, which only forbids value-level byte-equality vs LIVE).

**RETRACTED floor note (2026-06-12)**: the old "v6 matches the lower-bound exactly" claim missed the 13×13 `base13` active-grid witness family from the team-best graph. The remaining bullets below explain why the v6 family could not go below 3,330, but they are not an absolute task floor:
- F32 entry ≥ 845: only Cast converts dtype (shape-preserving), only Slice/Gather crop (dtype-preserving) ⇒ a 676 B F32 crop + 169 B cast is forced; margin exactly 1 (6s reach rows/cols 1 and 13).
- Boxed ≥ 845: **all four directions required — every 3-subset ray-AND has ≥359,612 false positives across 200k (LRU 366,468 / LRD 359,612 / LUD 363,476 / RUD 363,997); 2-subsets ≥1.8M** — plus 4 pools (676) and the variadic-Min collapse (169, the proven minimum: 1 tensor for a 4-way AND).
- e-witness ≥ 225 (LP-infeasible without it, proven twice); s15/P15 pads ≥ 450 (Concat dim-matching + e-ring); X ≥ 675 (≥3 channels must coexist in ONE tensor — no multi-operand free-output op handles 2 rewrite classes: Where's 3-operand select can't split 3-vs-4, rank-2 Sum/Add deltas can't place scattered masks).
- params ≥ 290 (W = 270 forced by C_out=10 × C_in=3 × 3×3; QLinearConv's 8 inputs mandatory — probed).
Σ = 3,330. Exact-value tails (Equal/OneHot) price ≥5,500 (need aP/sP interaction channels: consistent tap-set V = 11s+8e−5a01−4P+5aP−sP banked in the .update note; OneHot bonus fact: out-of-range indices → all-off, but i32-only indices ⇒ 3,600 B canvas).

**Floor argument (#68 discipline — final-op families enumerated and priced)**:
- *Free-output conv family (chosen)*: the only family where neither a 10-channel tensor nor any 30×30 plane ever exists. Within it: X ≥ 3 channels — ch6 needs s; ch4 needs P (LP-infeasibility: [T=4]-from-ΣL,R,U,D and A∧¬P are NOT linearly separable over (A,T,e,s) — worked through, two contradictions); ch8 needs an in-grid witness e (border-far cells must fire while all-zero-in-X outside cells must not) ⇒ X ≥ 675. F32 entry ≥ 676 (corpus margin exactly 1: 6s reach rows/cols 1 and 13). W = 270 forced by C_out=10 × C_in=3 × 3×3 (A-taps; the 1×1+a01-channel alternative trades −230 params for +450 mem = v5's safety premium). Dirs ≥ 4 planes + 3 ANDs (no pairing trick: Conv/MaxPool pads are shared per-op, so L/R/U/D can't share kernels without misalignment; counts-sum T can't replace the AND — proven above).
- *Equal-tail (#67)*: needs EXACT canvas values ⇒ exact 0/1 indicators ⇒ ~6 extra planes + 30×30 u8 pad (900) ≈ 5,700+. Dead.
- *BOOL-concat-tail (LIVE's class, modernized)*: Concat [1,10,15,15] BOOL 2,250 + indicator tax ≈ 7,800. Dead.
- *broadcast-Add / BitwiseAnd-intersection*: boxed(r,c) depends on position within the row/col (left AND right of c), not rank-2/row-set×col-set separable. Structurally dead.
- *Where/MatMul/Scatter/Resize tails*: operands ≥ canvas-size charged, or indices-params explode. Dead.

LIVE's 12,905 = the same rule paying the F16-plane tax: 16×450 sign-planes + 4,500 Concat + 225-param zero-plane. The u8 lanes + free-output conv eliminate the Concat and halve every plane.

**Post-floor re-attack (2026-06-07, ping 1/4) — additional kill-rows, all priced worse than 3,668**:
- *T-linearization*: T = ΣdL..dD admits valid integer taps (ch3 = 4·a01 − T − 4s; ch8 = 4e − 4a01 − T; ch4 = 2T − 7e − 10s — kept here for reuse) but costs the same 3 combine-ops as the P-chain; feeding the 4 dir channels into X to fold −T into the output conv = [1,7,15,15] 1,575 vs 1,407. +168, dead.
- *C_out<10 + channel-axis Pad*: Pad can't interleave zeros at {0,1,2,5,7,9}, and any op AFTER the conv un-frees it (charged [1,C,30,30]). Dead.
- *Mirror-shared dir pools* (neg-step Slice + 2-ch pool + un-mirror): 1,014 vs 338. Dead. BitwiseAnd-opset-18 AND-chain: tie (507). GE(T,4)+cast: 845 vs 507. CumSum: no u8 kernel, F16 planes 2×. Dead.

Don't claim "assumption-free" for any 3×3 free-output conv whose positive taps read a content channel — either corpus-certify the border margin (v4) or go center-only-positive (v5).
- 2026-06-07 | Equal-tail (#67) is NOT competitive here: exact canvas values need exact 0/1 indicators (~6 extra planes + 900 pad) ≈ 5,700 vs 3,668 sign-arithmetic. Sign-consuming rules should stay sign-arithmetic.
